sites.rationale: [Literature audit 2026-11-05 (deliverome-analysis PR 236), verdict region_only: insert_after_residue 146 -> NULL; the paper names a region, not a junction (region: at residue 146 (junction 145|146 or 146|147 not stated)). Paper (PMID 40552817): "CD317 with a Flag tag at residue 146 (CD317-Flag) was generated by PCR amplification and inserted into the lentiviral vector CSCA-MCS to create CSCA-CD317-Flag as described previously ( 29 ).". Audit note: 'At residue 146' does not state before/after/replacing V146 (junction 145|146 or 146|147 or substitution); the construct is from their ref 29, which was not checked. Species not stated (human implied by context). Surface not shown (western blot/IP only). Function: CD317-Flag overexpression restricts HHV-6 infection.] The clip states 'Flag tag at residue 146' in full-length CD317/BST2 in a lentiviral vector. Python confirms seq[145]='V' at position 146 and seq[146]='R' at position 147, both extracellular (residues 44-180), 103 residues from the TM boundary. The phrase 'at residue 146' is taken as insert_after_residue=146 (tag inserted after V146); a one-residue ambiguity (145 vs 146) exists but both readings place the tag in the same extracellular region. Full-length CD317 (BST2) with Flag tag at residue 146 (CD317-Flag) cloned into lentiviral vector CSCA-MCS for expression studies.

sites.rationale: The clip explicitly names the junction as Y154/P155 in full-length, membrane-anchored BST2 in a retroviral vector. Python confirms seq[153]='Y' and seq[154]='P', both within the extracellular domain (residues 44-180), 111 residues from the TM boundary. The mScarlet insertion with Gly/Ser linkers is a well-established tolerance test for an internal loop site. Full-length human BST2 (Bst2-WT-mScar) cloned into retroviral vector pQCXIH; mScarlet inserted between Y154 and P155 with flanking Gly/Ser linkers; construct expressed in mammalian cells for surface expression studies.

sources.claim:
HA‐tagged tetherin cDNAs were PCR'ed to add NotI and XhoI restriction sites and cloned into the retroviral vector, pQCXIH.
cDNAs for Bst2‐WT‐mScar and Bst2‐C3A‐mScar were synthesised by GeneWiz (Azenta Life Sciences) and cloned to pQCXIH between AgeI and BamHI restriction sites. mScarlet cDNA was cloned between position Y154/P155 of human Bst2 and separated by short, flexible (Gly/Ser) linkers.
pCMV‐Sport6‐CD63‐pHluorin was a gift from Dr Michiel Pegtel (Amsterdam UMC, Netherlands).
